component.name: mcode-webui
component.description: v2.0.0 industrializes the v1.x surface with append-only event stream + hash chain, independent anomaly SSE channel, per-request authorize() gate, interaction/feedback subsystem split, plugin metadata drift detector, CI matrix + SBOM + CVE, rate limiting, virtual chat list, cross-workspace session search, session export (Markdown / JSON), quota forecast, and token-onboarding modal. Zero npm dependencies; runs on Node 22+.
